item.description: Cisco president and chief product officer Jeetu Patel handed a 27-year-old, Padmanabhan Krishnamurthy — a former AI startup CEO whose company Cisco acquired — the job of rewriting 98% of Cisco's legacy code with just two people, an unlimited AI token budget and a 24-month target that starts with a four-week validation. item.description: Galta is an open-source infinite canvas that sits beside the browser: images you collect arrive with their web source, and you can sketch on the same canvas, then point Codex or Claude Code at one detail to continue. A public beta is installable, and the author is recruiting people who build visual reference boards to try it. Install needs Chrome 141+ or Dia; native agent connection also requires an Apple-silicon Mac on macOS 15 or newer.

item.description: The Shuishan (Metasequoia) input method has open-sourced its own trained Chinese IME language model for candidate ranking and prediction, released alongside two repos: a Windows-only clean build and a cross-platform version. The author pitched it inside a thread about reverse-engineering Sogou's IME and asked for stars. It's relevant to developers who want to tinker with a local input method or train their own model.

item.title: [infoq] 当AI从“会想”走向“会干”——腾讯云与英特尔共筑Agentic AI执行新底座
item.description: Tencent Cloud and Intel outline a joint infrastructure stack for agentic AI, where a request runs through a plan-reason-act-feedback loop and fans out into many tool and code calls, so the CPU is no longer merely a companion to the GPU. Two problems are framed: keeping task state alive across bursty workloads, and memory capacity, not core count, capping how many agents a node can host. Tencent Cloud's Cube Sandbox answers with compute and state elasticity, including pause, resume and snapshots.

item.title: [infoq] .NET 11 第 2 个候选版本发布，带来生产环境部署许可以及针对库、F#、MAUI 和 WinForms 的更新
item.description: Microsoft shipped .NET 11 RC2, which carries a go-live license for production deployment and is supported in Visual Studio 2026 Insiders and VS Code with the C# Dev Kit. Updates span libraries, runtime, SDK, NuGet, F#, ASP.NET Core, MAUI and WinForms, but add no new C# language features. The runtime emphasizes reliability, with a breaking change that disables advisory file locking by default on iOS and tvOS so backgrounded apps don't get killed.

item.title: [zhihu] DeepSeek4.1Pro 迟迟不发布的原因有哪些？
item.description: A Zhihu thread asks why the DeepSeek 4.1 Pro release keeps slipping. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, so there is no official explanation, roadmap hint or timeline to report — only that the version has yet to ship and users are speculating about the delay.

item.title: [github_trending] shiyu-coder/Kronos
item.description: Kronos is a foundation model for the language of financial markets, hosted on GitHub with a Hugging Face model page and a live demo. The repo displays stars, forks, and license badges, making its adoption status and license terms easy to gauge. For developers working on financial NLP or market language tasks, it's a practical starting point.

item.title: [github_trending] patchy631/ai-engineering-hub
item.description: ai-engineering-hub is a GitHub repository collecting 93+ production-ready projects and in-depth tutorials on LLMs, RAG and AI agent applications, organized by difficulty with 22 beginner-level entries. It targets developers who want runnable examples rather than theory, spanning newcomers, practitioners and researchers building their own agent systems.

item.title: [juejin] 一键还原任意网站，这套 Playwright + 多 Agent 工程流太猛了
item.description: The author, alien, walks through ai-website-cloner-template, which uses Playwright to capture a target page and then hands the work to multiple cooperating agents that rebuild the site's structure and styling, covering both usage and implementation. Frontend developers curious about how multi-agent setups split real tasks and drive browser automation will get the most from the architecture breakdown.

item.title: [juejin] DeepSeek Harness 值得安装的 15 款插件
item.description: A roundup picking out 15 plugins worth installing from the fast-growing community ecosystem around DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It works as a shortlist for developers already running DSH who want to extend it without auditioning every plugin themselves.

item.title: [juejin] 一个人+AI做情侣食谱小程序，30天纯赚
item.description: A solo developer's write-up on building a couples' recipe mini-program with AI help and running it for 30 days; revenue came in above the earlier "8 yuan in a month" experiment, enough to cover a milk tea with extra toppings. Aimed at indie developers curious about shipping a small AI-assisted product and closing the loop to real income.

item.title: [juejin] 甲方只给了一张卫星截图，我用 Three.js + Blender 建了一座 3D 能源站
item.description: Starting from a single satellite screenshot handed over by a client, the author rebuilt a 3D integrated energy station with Three.js and Blender: reverse-engineering the design camera from the image, scripting the modeling, baking a night scene in Cycles, then adding a truck reversing into a bay and an operations simulation, with a pixel-by-pixel overlay to check fidelity. Useful for front-end developers working on Web 3D visualization, digital twins, or reconstructing scenes from reference imag

item.title: [juejin] 基于 Pi，我居然自己搞了一个好用的 AI Agent 桌面工作台
item.description: The author built a personal AI Agent desktop workbench on top of Pi, arguing you don't have to hand-roll everything from model calls and the message loop through the tool protocol and permission system. It targets developers who want a working agent desktop setup without rebuilding the framework from scratch.

item.title: [juejin] 🚀 2026 年 9 月 GitHub 十大热门项目排行榜 🔥
item.description: A ranking of the ten hottest GitHub open-source projects for September 2026, whose shared direction the blurb describes as agents moving from writing lots of code toward more restrained, governable systems that act on the real world and organizational workflows. Only the title and that one-line description are available here; the individual projects aren't listed.
